Title: Submit Complaint
Scenario: User submits complaint with all mandatory fields and valid attachment
Preconditions: User is authenticated, categories and locations are configured
Input/Action: POST /complaints with category=valid, location=valid, description=non-empty, priority=Standard, attachment=valid_pdf
Expected Result: Complaint created with unique ID and status=Pending. Auto-assigned to caretaker. SLA timer started. Notifications sent.

Title: Submit Complaint
Scenario: User submits complaint without attachment (optional)
Preconditions: User is authenticated
Input/Action: POST /complaints with category=valid, location=valid, description=non-empty, priority=Urgent, no attachment
Expected Result: Complaint created with status=Pending. SLA=24h applied. Auto-assigned to caretaker.

Title: Submit Complaint
Scenario: Missing mandatory fields — category is null
Preconditions: User is authenticated
Expected Result: Submission rejected with validation error: category is required

Title: Submit Complaint
Scenario: Attachment exceeds size limit or has invalid file type
Preconditions: User is authenticated
Expected Result: File rejected with error. User prompted to retry with valid file.

Title: Submit Complaint
Scenario: Auto-assignment fails — no caretaker mapping found
Preconditions: User is authenticated, assignment policy has a gap
Input/Action: POST /complaints with category and location not covered in assignment policy
Expected Result: Complaint created with status=Pending-Assignment and escalated for manual assignment.

Title: Submit Complaint
Scenario: Complaint submitted with empty description
Preconditions: User is authenticated
Expected Result: Submission rejected with error: description cannot be empty

Title: Track Complaint Status
Scenario: User views list of own complaints and selects one for details
Preconditions: User is authenticated and has at least one complaint
Expected Result: Full complaint details shown: status timeline, assigned personnel, SLA deadline, history.

Title: Track Complaint Status
Scenario: User has no complaints
Preconditions: User is authenticated but has submitted no complaints
Expected Result: System displays empty state message: no complaints found.

Title: Track Complaint Status
Scenario: User attempts to view another user's complaint without authorization
Preconditions: User is authenticated
Expected Result: Access denied with authorization error.

Title: Update Complaint Progress
Scenario: Caretaker updates complaint status to In Progress with notes
Preconditions: Caretaker is authenticated and complaint is assigned
Input/Action: PATCH /complaints/{id} with status=In Progress, notes=non-empty, estimated_resolution_time=optional
Expected Result: Complaint status updated. Action logged. Complainant and supervisor notified.

Title: Update Complaint Progress
Scenario: Caretaker marks complaint as Resolved with resolution notes
Preconditions: Caretaker is authenticated and complaint is In Progress
Expected Result: Complaint status updated to Resolved. Complainant notified for verification.

Title: Update Complaint Progress
Scenario: Caretaker attempts invalid status transition
Preconditions: Caretaker is authenticated
Expected Result: Update rejected with invalid status transition error.

Title: Update Complaint Progress
Scenario: Issue is out of scope — caretaker escalates instead
Preconditions: Caretaker is authenticated
Input/Action: Caretaker selects Escalate option with justification
Expected Result: Complaint routed to escalation flow (UC-CM-004).

Title: Escalate Complaint (Manual/Automatic)
Scenario: Caretaker manually escalates complaint with justification
Preconditions: Caretaker is authenticated, complaint is assigned
Expected Result: Complaint status updated to Escalated. Reassigned to Supervisor. Supervisor notified.

Title: Escalate Complaint (Manual/Automatic)
Scenario: System auto-escalates complaint after SLA breach
Preconditions: Complaint is not resolved, time_since_creation > SLA_timeframe
Input/Action: System scheduler detects SLA breach for complaint_id
Expected Result: Complaint status updated to Escalated. Reassigned to Supervisor. Supervisor notified.

Title: Escalate Complaint (Manual/Automatic)
Scenario: Caretaker attempts escalation without providing justification
Preconditions: Caretaker is authenticated
Expected Result: Escalation rejected with error: justification is required.

Title: Escalate Complaint (Manual/Automatic)
Scenario: System error during escalation notification
Preconditions: SLA breach detected
Input/Action: System attempts to send escalation notification
Expected Result: Error logged. System retries notification delivery.

Title: Verify & Close Complaint
Scenario: Complainant accepts resolution — complaint closed
Preconditions: Complaint status=Resolved, complainant is authenticated
Expected Result: Complaint status updated to Closed. Feedback prompt triggered.

Title: Verify & Close Complaint
Scenario: Supervisor verifies resolution and closes complaint
Preconditions: Complaint status=Resolved, supervisor is authenticated
Expected Result: Complaint closed. Feedback prompt sent to complainant.

Title: Verify & Close Complaint
Scenario: Complainant rejects resolution — complaint reopened
Preconditions: Complaint status=Resolved, complainant is authenticated
Expected Result: Complaint status reverted to Reopened or reassigned.

Title: Verify & Close Complaint
Scenario: No response from complainant — supervisor verifies or system auto-closes
Preconditions: Complaint status=Resolved, complainant has not responded within window
Expected Result: Complaint auto-closed or closed by supervisor. Feedback prompt sent.

Title: Request Complaint Reopening
Scenario: Complainant requests reopen with valid justification within allowed window
Preconditions: Complaint status=Closed, complainant is authenticated, within reopen window
Expected Result: Complaint status updated to Reopened. Supervisor notified and complaint reassigned.

Title: Request Complaint Reopening
Scenario: Complainant submits reopen request without justification
Preconditions: Complaint status=Closed, complainant is authenticated
Expected Result: Request rejected with error: justification is required.

Title: Request Complaint Reopening
Scenario: Reopen request submitted outside allowed time window
Preconditions: Complaint status=Closed, reopen window has expired
Expected Result: Request denied with error: reopen window has expired.

Title: Provide Feedback on Complaint Resolution
Scenario: Complainant submits rating and comments after closure
Preconditions: Complaint status=Closed, system has prompted feedback
Expected Result: Feedback stored and linked to complaint. Admin notified for analysis.

Title: Provide Feedback on Complaint Resolution
Scenario: Complainant skips feedback prompt
Preconditions: Complaint status=Closed
Input/Action: User dismisses feedback prompt without submitting
Expected Result: No feedback record created. Complaint remains closed.

Title: Generate Reports & Analytics
Scenario: Supervisor generates report filtered by date range and category
Preconditions: Supervisor is authenticated, historical data exists
Expected Result: Report generated showing complaint frequency, resolution times, and trends for the filter.

Title: Generate Reports & Analytics
Scenario: No complaint data available for selected filters
Preconditions: Supervisor is authenticated, no data matches filters
Input/Action: GET /reports with filters that return no results
Expected Result: Empty report displayed with message: no data available for selected filters.

Title: SLA Reminder Notification
Scenario: System sends reminder when SLA deadline is approaching threshold
Preconditions: Complaint is unresolved, now() + notification_threshold > SLA_deadline
Input/Action: System scheduler evaluates complaint SLA deadlines
Expected Result: Reminder notification sent to caretaker and supervisor. Reminder logged in complaint history.

Title: SLA Reminder Notification
Scenario: Notification delivery fails
Preconditions: Reminder triggered but delivery service fails
Input/Action: System attempts to send SLA reminder notification
Expected Result: Error logged. System retries notification delivery.

Title: Auto Escalation
Scenario: System detects SLA breach and escalates complaint to Supervisor
Preconditions: Complaint status not in {Resolved, Closed}, time_since_creation > SLA_timeframe
Expected Result: Complaint status updated to Escalated. Reassigned to Supervisor. Supervisor notified.

Title: Auto Escalation
Scenario: Escalation notification fails during auto-escalation
Preconditions: Auto-escalation triggered, notification service unavailable
Expected Result: Error logged. System retries notification.

Title: Auto Escalation
Scenario: Complaint remains unresolved beyond SLA despite escalation
Preconditions: Complaint already escalated but Supervisor has not acted
Expected Result: Complaint remains unresolved. Admin notified for intervention.

Title: Reopen Complaint
Scenario: Complainant submits reopen request with justification within allowed timeframe
Preconditions: Complaint status=Closed, request within allowed window, justification provided
Expected Result: Complaint status updated to Reopened. Supervisor notified. Complaint reassigned.

Title: Reopen Complaint
Scenario: Reopen request submitted outside allowed timeframe
Preconditions: Complaint status=Closed, reopen window has expired
Expected Result: Request rejected with error: outside allowed reopen timeframe.

Title: Reopen Complaint
Scenario: Reopen request submitted without justification
Preconditions: Complaint status=Closed, within allowed window
Expected Result: Request rejected automatically with error: justification required.

Title: Admin Oversight
Scenario: Admin reviews overdue complaints dashboard and reassigns
Preconditions: Admin is authenticated, overdue/escalated complaints exist
Expected Result: Complaint reassigned. Admin intervention logged in complaint history.

Title: Admin Oversight
Scenario: Admin cannot find available caretaker — escalates to Service Authority
Preconditions: Admin is authenticated, no caretaker available
Input/Action: Admin selects escalate to Service Authority option
Expected Result: Complaint escalated to Service Authority.
